4125-diary-of-samuel-pepys-complete-1660.creator: Samuel Pepys
4125-diary-of-samuel-pepys-complete-1660.description: A book by Samuel Pepys. It has now been decided that the whole of the Diary shall be made public, with the exception of a few passages which cannot possibly be printed. It may be thought by some that these omissions are due to an unnecessary squeamishness, but it is not really so, and readers are therefore asked to have faith in the judgment of the editor.

7278-horace.title: Horace
7278-horace.creator: Theodore Martin
7278-horace.description: A book by Theodore Martin. nt is not pitched in too high a key for the unimaginative, but it is always so genuine that the most imaginative feel its charm. His wisdom is deeper than it seems, so simple, practical, and direct as it is in its application; and his moral teaching more spiritual and penetrating than is apparent on a superficial study.

arxiv-1901-11471.title: Improved strong-coupling perturbation theory of the symmetric Anderson impurity model
arxiv-1901-11471.creator: Kou-Han Ma, Ning-Hua Tong
arxiv-1901-11471.description: Abstract In a previous work (N. H. Tong, Phys. Rev. B 92 , 165126 (2015)), an equation-of-motion based series expansion formalism was used to do the second-order strong-coupling expansion for the single-particle Green function of the Anderson impurity model. In this paper, we improve this theory in two aspects.

arxiv-2102-04398.title: Approximation of Discontinuous Functions by Kantorovich Exponential Sampling Series
arxiv-2102-04398.description: Abstract . The Kantorovich exponential sampling series I w χ ​ f I_{w}^{\chi}f at jump discontinuities of the bounded measurable signal f : ℝ + → ℝ f:\mathbb{R}^{+}\rightarrow\mathbb{R} has been analysed. A representation lemma for the series I w χ ​ f I_{w}^{\chi}f is established and using this lemma certain approximation theorems for discontinuous signals are proved.

arxiv-2109-07028.title: Avengers Ensemble! Improving Transferability of Authorship Obfuscation
arxiv-2109-07028.creator: *, Fareed Zaffar, Padmini Srinivasan, Zubair Shafiq
arxiv-2109-07028.description: Abstract Stylometric approaches have been shown to be quite effective for real-world authorship attribution. To mitigate the privacy threat posed by authorship attribution, researchers have proposed automated authorship obfuscation approaches that aim to conceal the stylometric artefacts that give away the identity of an anonymous document’s author.

arxiv-2209-08314.title: (Anti)(hyper)nuclei production in small collision systems measured with ALICE at the LHC
arxiv-2209-08314.description: Abstract The production mechanism of (anti)nuclei in ultrarelativistic hadronic collisions is under intense debate in the scientific community. The description of the experimental measurements is currently based on two competing phenomenological models: the statistical hadronization model and the coalescence approach. Light (anti)nuclei have been extensively measured in small collision systems, namely pp and p–Pb collisions, with ALICE at the LHC.

arxiv-2211-01633.title: Cooperative Maneuvers of Highly Automated Vehicles at Urban Intersections: A Game-theoretic Approach
arxiv-2211-01633.creator: Björn Koopmann, Stefan Puch, Günter Ehmen and Martin Fränzle OFFIS e.V., Escherweg 2, 26121 Oldenburg, Germany { koopmann,puch,ehmen,fraenzle } @offis.de
arxiv-2211-01633.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose an approach how connected and highly automated vehicles can perform cooperative maneuvers such as lane changes and left-turns at urban intersections where they have to deal with human-operated vehicles and vulnerable road users such as cyclists and pedestrians in so-called mixed traffic.

arxiv-2410-12649.title: Faster Algorithms for Growing Collision-Free Convex Polytopes in Robot Configuration Space
arxiv-2410-12649.creator: Peter Werner, Thomas Cohn ⋆, Rebecca H. Jiang, Tim Seyde, Max Simchowitz, Russ Tedrake, Daniela Rus
arxiv-2410-12649.description: Abstract We propose two novel algorithms for constructing convex collision-free polytopes in robot configuration space. Finding these polytopes enables the application of stronger motion-planning frameworks such as trajectory optimization with Graphs of Convex Sets [ 1 ] and is currently a major roadblock in the adoption of these approaches.

arxiv-2412-03762.title: Extended Poincaré Symmetry Dictates Massive Scattering Amplitudes
arxiv-2412-03762.creator: Yu-Han Ni, Yi-Ning Wang, Chao Wu, Jiang-Hao Yu
arxiv-2412-03762.description: Abstract We identify an extended Poincare symmetry I ​ S ​ O ​ ( 2 ) × I ​ S ​ O ​ ( 3 , 1 ) ISO(2)\times ISO(3,1) for on-shell massive scattering amplitudes, transforming under the U ⁡ ( 2 ) U(2) Little group symmetry.

arxiv-2503-21462.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jinzhao Pan, Ye Tian. arxiv-2601-07373.title: On the Enumeration of Generalized Cospectral Mates of Graphs
arxiv-2601-07373.creator: Muhammad Raza, Obaid Ullah Ahmad, Mudassir Shabbir, Waseem Abbas
arxiv-2601-07373.description: Abstract This paper investigates the enumeration of generalized cospectral mates of simple graphs, where the generalized spectrum consists of the spectra of a graph and its complement. Moving beyond the classical problem of identifying graphs determined by their generalized spectrum, we address the more quantitative question of how many non-isomorphic graphs can share the same generalized spectrum.

pmc-10558360.description: The fourteenth annual workshop of the European Network for Breast Development and Cancer (ENBDC) on Methods in Mammary Gland Biology and Breast Cancer was held on April 26th − 29th in Weggis, Switzerland. For the first time, early career researchers organised and took part in an additional ECR workshop on the 26th of April, which was received with great enthusiasm.

pmc-11340212.title: Efficacy of corticosteroids in patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome: a meta-analysis
pmc-11340212.creator: Guowei Li, Dunfan Chen, Feng Gao, Wei Huang, Jin Wang, Yonglin Li, Baijian Chen, Yuejia Zhong, Rui Chen, Manhua Huang
pmc-11340212.description: BackgroundAcute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), are respiratory diseases with high morbidity and mortality. Clinical trials investigating the efficacy of corticosteroids in the treatment of ARDS often yield contradictory results. We hereby conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to investigate the efficacy of corticosteroids in ARDS management.

pmc-11428282.title: Taxonomic Diversity and Interannual Variation of Fish in the Lagoon of Meiji Reef (Mischief Reef), South China Sea
pmc-11428282.creator: Yuyan Gong, Jun Zhang, Zuozhi Chen, Yancong Cai, Yutao Yang
pmc-11428282.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryCoral reef fish diversity forms the foundation of their adaptability. A comprehensive understanding of coral reef fish diversity is crucial for the conservation of both coral reefs and their associated fish species. In this study, we employed three taxonomic diversity indices to analyze the characteristics and changes in taxonomic diversity within a representative coral reef (Meiji Reef) located in the South China Sea from 1998 to 2018.

pmc-11455985.title: Experimental evolution under different nutritional conditions changes the genomic architecture and virulence of Acinetobacter baumannii
pmc-11455985.creator: Sohyeon Yun, Jihyeon Min, Sunyong Han, Ho Seok Sim, Se Kye Kim, Jun Bong Lee, Jang Won Yoon, Jinki Yeom, Woojun Park
pmc-11455985.description: This study uncovers the molecular processes governing the adaptive evolution of multidrug-resistant (MDR) pathogens without antibiotic pressure. Genomic analysis of MDR Acinetobacter baumannii cells cultured for 8000 generations under starvation conditions (EAB1) or nutrient-rich conditions (EAB2) revealed significant genomic changes, primarily by insertion sequence (IS)-mediated insertions and deletions.

pmc-11490704.title: Unusual case report of bifocal gastrointestinal stromal tumor in the first jejunal loop uncovered by severe hemorrhage
pmc-11490704.creator: Med Dheker Touati, Ahmed Bouzid, Mohamed Raouf Ben Othmane, Anis Belhadj, Faouzi Chebbi, Ahmed Saidani
pmc-11490704.description: Introduction and importanceGastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs) are rare mesenchymal tumors, constituting 1 % of gastrointestinal tumors. Jejunal GISTs are even rarer. This article describes a unique bifocal jejunal GIST case, revealed by an exceptionally rare instance of massive hemorrhage.Case presentationWe present a 60-year-old female admitted for two days of melena. Despite being hemodynamically stable, severe anemia was noted.

pmc-11561475.title: Addressing the Silent Crisis of Oral Health in Conflict Areas and War Zones

pmc-11561475.description: tinue to displace millions, stripping them of their basic rights to security, clean water, food, shelter and access to healthcare. The statistics are staggering. pmc-11611734.title: Do we neglect nutrition in childhood interstitial lung disease?
pmc-11611734.creator: Nagehan Emiralioglu, Nural Kiper
pmc-11611734.description: Growth failure and inadequate weight gain are common problems in childhood interstitial lung diseases (chILD) and these children usually need high calories. It is important to manage both pulmonary functions and nutrition as part of their overall treatment plan and early interventions will help children to improve their quality of life and slow the progression of chronic lung disease.

pmc-11713858.title: An Innovative Community‐led Education and Recruitment Program to increase Clinical Research Participation Among Black Americans
pmc-11713858.creator: Bahar Niknejad, Ethlyn McQueen Gibson, Travonia Brown‐Hughes, Katie McDonough, Ebony Andrews, Deborah Hudson, Hamid Okhravi
pmc-11713858.description: BackgroundPrevious studies attest to a lack of awareness about Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) and limited participation of Black Americans in AD clinical trials. The AHEAD Study is a multicenter trial focused on preventing AD by evaluating the effectiveness and safety of Lecanemab in individuals with preclinical AD. The study aims to recruit at least 15% from underrepresented populations, including Black Americans.

pmc-12566671.title: Developmental Regulation of the Murine Selenoproteome Across Embryonic and Postnatal Stages: Implications for Human Nutrition and Health
pmc-12566671.creator: Shan-Shan Wang, Tong Li, Cheng-Jia Wei, Lan-Yu Cui, Vincenzo Triggiani
pmc-12566671.description: Background/Objectives: Selenoproteins play indispensable roles in embryonic development, with their dysregulation linked to various metabolic and neurological disorders. This study aims to systematically quantify the mRNA expression levels of all 24 selenoprotein genes in murine heart, brain, liver, and kidney tissues across embryonic (E8.5, E12.5, E18.

pmc-12641268.title: Developing a general AI model for integrating diverse genomic modalities and comprehensive genomic knowledge
pmc-12641268.creator: Zhenhao Zhang, Xinyu Bao, Linghua Jiang, Xin Luo, Zheyu Zhang, Jing Yin, Meiqi Zhao, Yichun Wang, Annelise Comai, Joerg Waldhaus, Anders S Hansen, Wenbo Li, Jie Liu
pmc-12641268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Advances in next-generation sequencing technologies have vastly expanded the availability of diverse genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic data, presenting the opportunity to develop a general AI model that integrates comprehensive genomic knowledge into a unified model. Unlike previous predictive models, which are typically specialized to certain tasks, our general AI model unifies a wide range of genomic modalities, such as nascent RNA and ultra-high-resolution chromatin organization, within a multi-task architecture.

pmc-12787038.title: AI Decision-Making Performance in Maternal–Fetal Medicine: Comparison of ChatGPT-4, Gemini, and Human Specialists in a Cross-Sectional Case-Based Study
pmc-12787038.creator: Matan Friedman, Amit Slouk, Noa Gonen, Laura Guzy, Yael Ganor Paz, Kira Nahum Sacks, Amihai Rottenstreich, Eran Weiner, Ohad Gluck, Ilia Kleiner
pmc-12787038.description: Background/Objectives: Large Language Models (LLMs), including ChatGPT-4 and Gemini, are increasingly incorporated into clinical care; however, their reliability within maternal–fetal medicine (MFM), a high-risk field in which diagnostic and management errors may affect both the pregnant patient and the fetus, remains uncertain.

pmc-13494724.creator: Andrea C. Villanti, Marisa Tomaino, Amanda Johnson, Jeannie Garmon, Aila Altunbilek, Olivia A. Wackowski, Ollie Ganz, Charity A. Ntansah, Jon-Patrick Allem, Kevin R. J. Schroth, Craig S. Fryer, Kymberle Landrum Sterling
pmc-13494724.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Key PointsQuestionWhat are the sources and content of public comments related to the US Food and Drug Administration’s proposed rulemaking on menthol cigarettes (MCs) and flavored cigars (FCs)?FindingsIn this qualitative study of 246 808 public comments, form letters dominated comments (97% for MCs; 93% for FCs), and content tied to tobacco companies was identified in 44% of MC comments and 12% of FC comments.
